name: RecQ like helicase
pathways: double-strand break repair via homologous recombination

function.text: RECQL encodes ATP-dependent DNA helicase Q1. Annotated molecular activities include ATP hydrolysis activity and DNA helicase activity. It participates in DNA repair and double-strand break repair via homologous recombination.
